Warner Bros. Entertainment Inc. v. Midjourney, Inc.
Disney Enterprises, Inc. and Universal v. Midjourney, Inc.

profile_text.body:
Midjourney is a for-profit independent research lab founded in 2021 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as exploring new mediums of thought and expanding the imaginative powers of the human species, with projects organized around themes it lists as imagination, coordination, reflection, beauty, and human flourishing.

The company's primary tracked product is its image generation tool, also called Midjourney, which operates through its website and is categorized under image and graphic design. IP provenance has been flagged as relevant to the product.

Midjourney carries significant legal exposure, with 174 matters recorded in California and active cases in federal court. These include EVOX Production LLC v. Midjourney, Inc. and Warner Bros. Entertainment Inc. v. Midjourney, Inc. in the Central District of California, Disney Enterprises, Inc. and Universal v. Midjourney, Inc. also in the Central District, and participation as a named party in Andersen v. Stability AI Ltd. in the Northern District of California. These cases collectively reflect ongoing copyright-related litigation surrounding AI image generation.
